description: This file defines an 'Emitter' class used for generating and managing code or text output, with methods for indentation, block management, and line handling.

classes.name: Emitter
classes.description: A class for emitting formatted code or text with support for indentation, block management, and line buffering.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing the emitter with file name, indentation size, max line length, and autoindent option.

methods.name: __enter__
methods.description: Enables use of 'with' statement context management.

methods.name: __exit__
methods.description: Handles cleanup on exiting context, flushing and closing the file if open.

methods.name: Line
methods.description: Adds a line of text to the buffer, handling indentation, line wrapping, and autoindentation.

methods.name: Prepend
methods.description: Prepends lines from another emitter object.

methods.name: Append
methods.description: Appends lines from another emitter object.

methods.name: FileName
methods.description: Returns the filename associated with the emitter.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Writes buffered lines to the output file.

methods.name: EnterBlock
methods.description: Starts a new code block, optionally conditioned.

methods.name: ExitBlock
methods.description: Ends a code block, optionally conditioned.

methods.name: If
methods.description: Starts an 'if' block if conditions are present.

methods.name: Endif
methods.description: Ends an 'if' block if conditions are present.

methods.name: Else
methods.description: Starts an 'else' block if conditions are present.
